title: A part stocked at two selected locations shows as two per-location rows
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4); user with access to at least two locations.
preconditions: 1. The same part number is stocked as an inventory part at two locations the user can access, with different On Hand / Min / Max values at each.
2. You are on the Parts Velocity report with both locations selected in the Location filter.
steps: 1. Search for the part number in the toolbar search.
2. Count the rows returned for it and read each row's On Hand, Min, and Max.
expected:
1. The part appears as TWO inventory rows - one per selected location (an inventory part is a per-location stock record).
2. Each row carries only that one location's On Hand, Min, and Max.
3. On Hand / Min / Max are NEVER summed across locations.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 10 (S3-R1a), read on 17 August 2026.
